How to rank up solo in Mobile Legends: heroes and star maths

At a 55% win rate, Legend V to Mythic takes roughly 250 matches in a simple star model. At 60%, it takes around 125.

Solo queue heroes

In this story

  1. How many matches 25 stars take
  2. Solo queue picks by lane
  3. Heroes from Epic to Glory
  4. What else helps you collect stars

In this story
How many matches 25 stars takeSolo queue picks by laneHeroes from Epic to GloryWhat else helps you collect stars

In brief

  • At a 50% win rate your stars stand still on average: every loss takes back what a win gave.
  • At 55% wins the road from Legend V to Mythic (25 stars) takes about 250 matches, at 60% about 125.
  • The best solo heroes in Legend and Mythic by MOONTON’s 30-day statistics: Minsitthar, Ling, Valir, Hanabi and Rafaela.
  • Belerick and Atlas win the most in Epic but fall to 50% by Mythical Glory. Saber and Moskov are the opposite: stronger at the top.

The solo hero data covers 30 days ending on 23 November 2026. The match estimates below assume a constant win rate.

How many matches 25 stars take

A win gives a star and a loss takes one. So on average a match earns your win share minus your loss share. At 55% that is 0.1 stars per game, and the 25 Legend stars turn into roughly 250 matches. The estimate is rough: star protection and promotion points in Epic and Legend speed things up a little, but the order of magnitude is right.

Legend V → Mythic: 25 stars at different win rates
Win rateStars per match on averageMatches to Mythic
50%0Your rank stands still
52%0.04About 625
55%0.1About 250
60%0.2About 125

Not counting star protection or promotion points.

The main takeaway: even a couple of extra percent of wins saves hundreds of matches. What matters most is not how many games you play in an evening but which heroes you play them on and in what state.

Solo queue picks by lane

We took heroes picked in at least 0.6% of matches and banned in less than 25% — the ones you can actually get in solo queue. Then we sorted them by win rate in Legend and Mythic, where most players get stuck.

Gold Lane is weak this month: apart from Hanabi, no popular marksman holds noticeably more than 50% wins. The jungle looks similar, with Ling clearly ahead of the rest. If you play these lanes, your hero choice matters more here than anywhere else.

Heroes from Epic to Glory

Some heroes’ win rates change a lot with rank. Easy-to-learn tanks win at the bottom, while in Mythical Glory players already know how to play against them. Mechanically demanding heroes go the other way.

How win rate changes from Epic to Mythical Glory
HeroEpicMythical Glory
Belerick55.96%50.01%
Atlas55.55%49.84%
Johnson52.61%46.81%
Saber48.42%53.51%
Moskov46.77%51.31%
Xavier48.54%52.66%

In Epic or Legend, Belerick and Atlas are a reliable way to collect stars. Closer to Honor it is worth moving to heroes that keep their strength at the top.

What else helps you collect stars

  • Keep two or three heroes of one role plus a backup for a neighbouring lane. Your win rate is higher on a familiar hero than on a new one.
  • Learn your heroes’ counters: every hero page in our tier list shows the five heroes they lose to.
  • Stop after two losses in a row. A tilted streak usually costs more stars than it brings.
  • Do not spend ranked games on experiments: try a new hero in Classic first.
  • In Epic and Legend play for performance: good matches build promotion points, and a full star protection bar saves you from a loss.

Frequently asked questions

How many matches does it take to reach Mythic from Legend?

From Legend V to Mythic is 25 stars. At 55% wins that is about 250 matches, at 60% about 125, not counting star protection or promotion points.

Why is my rank not going up even though I win often?

At 50% wins your stars stand still on average: a win gives a star and a loss takes it. You only climb above 50%, and every percent shortens the road a lot.

Which heroes should I play for solo queue in MLBB?

By MOONTON’s 30-day statistics, the best available heroes in Legend and Mythic are Minsitthar in the EXP Lane, Ling in the jungle, Valir in mid, Hanabi in the Gold Lane and Rafaela at roam.
